check.rationale: Only inspects files and reports formatting violations without modifying anything.

config.rationale: Parent command for configuration management; its subcommands (init, update, add, edit) all modify the configuration file.

fmt.rationale: Reformats source files in place; effect is expected, bounded by file patterns, and reversible via git or re-running.

output-file-paths.rationale: Prints resolved file paths for inspection based on configuration without modifying state.
